prerequisites: Ability to complete work independently within a mainly online environment and a given framework of time.
LC-1124 Writing Skills for Engineers 1 (for written part of foreign language requirement)
LC-1126 Writing Skills for Engineers 2 (for written part of foreign language requirement)

learning_outcomes.text: Identify the influence of audience on presentation content, style, and organization.
Create a speech outline to ensure a clear organisation of contents, including an introduction, body, conclusion, and transitional statements.
Deliver an elevator pitch on a topic related to their field of study in English.

Navigate and adapt their communication styles in an online and/or on-site environment, fostering clear and concise exchanges. They understand the increased importance of active listening, empathetic responses, constructive feedback, and providing mutual support when online as well as on-site.

Develop their capacity for self-reflection and adaptability in an asynchronous learning context. They can assess their own communication strengths and weaknesses, identify areas for growth, and proactively seek feedback.
Develop their information retrieval skills in the digital environment as well as find and assess reliable sources in the digital environment.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of background and experiences as presenters and users of English
Establishing personal goals and areas of development for presenting
Analysis of elevator pitches to identify effective elements
Creating an outline for a pitch: introduction, body, conclusion, transitions
Creating a final version of the pitch
